positions.title: Marketing Lead/Web Developer
positions.description:
Manage brand websites modifying functionality and content as needed. 
Custom Shopify theme development using Themekit (also experienced with Slate). Worked with UX designer to create a new website. Using CSS Grid for responsive layouts, liquid metafields for custom content. Main features included more detailed product pages and an overhauled support section of the website.  

Created a company wiki with Mediawiki.

Created a Watt Calculator with vanilla javascript to enable customers to find the correct inverter for their needs. 

Improved internal processes including setting up version control with Bitbucket, writing documentation for future devs, using forms to streamline tasks. 

A/B testing with Google Optimize.

Provide marketing support including: Amazon Marketing Services, Google Ads, content creation, product testing, monthly reports, PR coordination, email marketing with mailchimp and more.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Provided web development and marketing support for a San Diego-based professional organizer.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Redesigned the Bike Coalition's website. The new site aims to help increase their membership-base, spread awareness and increase overall engagement with the organization. As a small nonprofit, it was also important for all members of their team to be able to make updates to the content. Following the redesign, I provided staff training, created a user guide, and put a project management tool in place to improve their workflow.

positions.title: Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
° Gathered website requirements from various stakeholders and created solutions to achieve their goals. Provided monthly reports of traffic, usage and effectiveness and adjusted strategies and content accordingly.
° Served as the main contact with graphic designers, printers and mail house companies. Collaborated with internal customers to determine project theme, format, copy, photos, timeline and budget.
° Worked with integrated marketing vendor on all components of annual advertising campaign.
° Created and managed internship program for the development and community relations team.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Worked with the site optimization team to implement and edit features to improve customer experience and increase profits. I gained experience working with the Angular framework, writing unit tests, and participating in the agile scrum process.

positions.title: Membership/Development Coordinator
positions.description:
°  Worked with agency to redesign the website. Met with committees to evaluate the needs of the new site, guide layout and customizations, reviewed and edited wireframes, edited/wrote new website copy and more.
° Used email marketing and online fundraising strategies to strengthen and increase annual membership and private donor base.

positions.title: Development & Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
° Worked with team to implement a new donor-centric website resulting in a 58%increase in online revenue.
° Increased Facebook fan base by 40% by running Facebook ad campaigns and generating new and varied content to drive activity.
° Created and managed all email marketing efforts.
